adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `hubspotRefreshToken` is typed as `HubspotToken` but is assigned from `refreshOAuthTokens(...)`. Per the new `refreshOAuthTokens` helper, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` it returns the result of `fetch(...)` (a `Response` object), not a Hubspot token payload. Hubspot’s code does not validate/parse this (unlike other integrations that use `parseRefreshTokenResponse`), so under credential-sync mode this will produce a type/shape mismatch and likely break downstream logic that expects Hubspot token fields.
